reports.comments:
Baxter is experiencing a temporary shortage of TISSEEL Kit (Lyophilized Powders with Diluents for Topical Application) in Canada.

Affected products:
1503152 - TISSEEL Fibrin Sealant – Lyophilized Kit – 2ML
1503153 – TISSEEL Fibrin Sealant – Lyophilized Kit – 4ML
1503154 - TISSEEL Fibrin Sealant – Lyophilized Kit – 10ML

To help mitigate the impact of the shortage, TISSEEL Frozen (Solutions for Thawing for Topical Application) may be available as an alternative product, where clinically appropriate.

Alternative products:
5500381 – TISSEEL PRIMA VHSD SA FROZEN - 2 ML
5500382 – TISSEEL PRIMA VHSD SA FROZEN – 4 ML
5500383 – TISSEEL PRIMA VHSD SA FROZEN – 10 ML

TISSEEL Kit and TISSEEL Frozen are both presentations of TISSEEL 500 IU/mL and are available in 2 mL, 4 mL and 10 mL total volumes. The Canadian Product Monograph states that following reconstitution of the TISSEEL Kit, the resulting concentrations of the Sealer Protein-Aprotinin and Thrombin-Calcium Chloride solutions are the same as those in the Frozen presentation. Customers are encouraged to reference the product monograph for more information and contact their Baxter representative should they be interested in a substitution. 

In addition to the Fibrin Sealant options listed above, Baxter also offers other alternative products for hemostasis, sealing or tissue adherence. It is recommended that customers contact their local Baxter Advanced Surgery Representative to discuss their specific clinical needs to determine the  best possible alternative for their practice.
